name: Tree Stride
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

You may step into one living tree and emerge from another within far range once per round. Both trees must be alive and larger than you.

Entering one tree and emerging from the other costs 5 ft of movement in total.

Describe your movement.

improvements.name: Home Tree
improvements.description:
You may spend 8 hours communing with a living tree to become spiritually entwined with it. If you are already entwined with a different tree, that bond ends and is replaced by the new one.

Whenever you use Tree Stride, you may choose the entwined tree as your destination, regardless of its distance from you.

If the entwined tree is damaged, you feel its pain and check a Condition, no matter where you are. If it is felled, you take 2d10 damage and check two Conditions.
